name: music_multiline_editor
description: Listening test: multi-line editor — separate patterns stacked via Music Drawer. Open Ctrl+M to watch lines update.
script: announce MULTI-LINE EDITOR TESTS — open Ctrl+M to watch
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=0.5
# === 2. Two lines: melody + bass (pipe = separate lines in drawer) ===
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5, c2 ~ c2 ~] cps=0.5
announce 3/6: Three lines — melody + bass + euclidean
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5, c2 ~ e2 ~, c5(3,8)] cps=0.5
announce 4/6: Different voices — flute melody over string chords
strudel [[c4 e4 g4 c5]*2, [c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4]] s=flute cps=0.4
# === 5. Fast swap — verify no stacking artifacts ===
announce 5/6: Rapid swap — should be clean transitions
strudel c4 e4 g4 c5 cps=0.5
strudel [c4 e4 g4 c5]*4 s=marimba cps=0.7
strudel c3 ~ e3 ~ g3 ~ s=bass cps=0.8
announce 6/6: Full composition — chords + arpeggio + bass
notify {SCRIPT} "How did the multi-line editor work?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
